title: 8 Signs You've Quietly Started Doing This Faith Thing Alone
caption:
Nobody drifts loudly. It's always quiet first. A missed call here, a real answer swapped for a text there, until one day the guys who used to know your name don't know your Tuesday nights anymore.

You pray, but haven't said the real thing out loud to a person in months. God already knows. You're the one who needs to hear yourself say it. Every accountability conversation happens through a screen, and a text can't see your face when you're lying.

You measure your walk with God by content, not conversation. You'd rather confess to a stranger online than a man who knows your name, because anonymity feels safe when it costs you nothing. You can't remember who last corrected you. Iron doesn't sharpen iron from a distance (Proverbs 27:17).

You call it independence. God calls it isolation. Save this and text one brother the real thing today.
